verdict.rationale: SerpApi is an HTTP API (`https://serpapi.com/search?engine=google`) authenticated by API key. Official client libraries are invoked from plain scripts, an async submit-and-retrieve-later mode exists, and Bearer-token auth works for the MCP path. That makes it inherently headless and scriptable, and community users confirm it is used programmatically by scripts and AI tools. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions, env-var key handling), an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and hands-on evidence of CI usage specifically.
